description: Local WebUI for AI conversations, document reading, selection research, and source return

interface.shortDescription: Local WebUI for AI-assisted reading and research
interface.longDescription: Collector is a single-user local WebUI for AI conversations, document reading, in-place selection analysis, research branches, later learning, and reliable source return. A local Node service provides the WebUI, SQLite data, file parsing, model access, and background task recovery.
